VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Meta.Description: Interior joinery around the lantern upstand: a selectable cornice, a fixed 12mm plywood packer behind it, and an 18mm eaves trim whose top edge follows the roof pitch. Swept around the same eaves datum ring as the base frame.
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Meta.SectionFrameNote: All parts use Na__Asset__Plan2D__Top as the sweep section, matching the base frame convention. Section 0,0 is the EAVES DATUM POINT. Section +x runs inboard into the room (cornice and packer sit on the positive-x side). Section -y runs down toward the seating benchmark at y=-100 and below. Section +y runs up. The eaves trim top edge is authored to the reference pitch plane y = x * tan(ReferencePitchDegrees); at any other pitch InteriorJoineryAssembly remaps top-edge vertices onto the current pitch plane.
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Meta.ReferencePitchNote: atan(6.551/18) from the exported eaves trim top at x=18. Matches the base frame weathered-top reference pitch.
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Meta.HandAuthoredNote: Written by hand rather than generated. A folder scan cannot know which asset fills which slot, or which cornice option is the default.
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Meta.AssetResolutionNote: Parts name an AssetId and nothing else. The file behind an id is resolved through VghLantern__AssetRegistry__.json, which is the one place a path is written down. LibraryRoot and the per part JsonUrl were removed on 21-Aug-2026.

VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Parts.AlwaysPresentNote: Optional. Empty CorniceOptionId means No Cornice - cornice and packer are both omitted from the assembly.
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Parts.SpecFinishNote: Paint finish matches the job Joinery Paint Finish (same palette as glaze bar trims).
VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Parts.Description: A decorative cornice that runs around the interior of the lantern upstand.

VghLantern__InteriorJoinerySystem__Parts.Description: A painted timber infill piece that clads the back of the base frame under the eaves. Its top most edge is adjusted with the roof lantern pitch so it does not clip through on steeper pitches.
